description: Network diagnostics toolkit: ping, traceroute, DNS, LAN scan, port scan & more NetLens is a comprehensive network diagnostics toolkit for Android. Inspect, diagnose, and monitor your network from a single app — no ads, no tracking, open source under AGPL-3.0. Network Info - IP Info — look up your public IP address and geolocation - WHOIS — query domain and IP ownership records Connectivity - Ping — test latency and reachability with single or continuous mode - DNS Lookup — query A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, and other record types - Traceroute — trace the full network path to any host - Speed Test — measure download, upload, and latency Discovery - LAN Scan — discover devices on your local network with MAC vendor identification - Devices — a persistent inventory of devices you have seen, with your own names, tags, and notes - mDNS Browser — find Bonjour and .local services on the network - Port Scanner — scan for open TCP ports on any target - Wi-Fi Analyzer — nearby networks, signal strength, and channel usage Security & Web - Wi-Fi Audit — check the network you join for weak ciphers and WPS - VPN Status and DNS Leak Test — see whether your traffic escapes the tunnel - TLS Inspector — inspect SSL/TLS certificates and cipher suites - HTTP Tester — send custom HTTP requests and inspect responses Tools - Wake-on-LAN — send magic packets to wake network devices - Endpoint Monitor — track uptime and latency of HTTP endpoints over time - Network Log — view connection history and network events - History — browse past scan results with search and filtering Home Screen Widget Configurable widget for at-a-glance network status right on your home screen. Built with Jetpack Compose, Material 3, and modern Android architecture. Requires Android 10+. Pro Optional Pro unlocks extras such as background watching of your home network, which notifies you when a new device joins, and sharing results. The open-source FOSS build, which you compile from source, has every feature unlocked. Privacy No accounts, analytics, or ads. Some tools send your public IP, or an address you look up, to third-party services listed in the privacy policy. Open Source Licensed under AGPL-3.0. Source code available on GitHub.
